test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The budget expenditure of the government is broadly classified into how many categories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The expenditure Budget is classified into **two broad categories**.
 
• They are **capital expenditure** and **revenue expenditure**.
 
• Capital expenditure is the amount spent on creating assets. It is a cause for a reduction in the government's liabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Essential Budget Categories**

 
• Housing (25-35 percent)
 
• Transportation (10-15 percent)
 
• Food (10-15 percent)
 
• Utilities (5-10 percent)
 
• Insurance (10-25 percent)
 
• Medical & Healthcare (5-10 percent)
 
• Saving, Investing, & Debt Payments (10-20 percent)
 
• Personal Spending (5-10 percent)
